description: A random voltage generator whose probability curve, range and lean are all tunable, drawing a new value on a trigger or continuously

params.text: Sets the upper end of the range random values are drawn from, -10V to 10V; if it is set below the other limit the two are swapped
Shapes the probability curve, 0 to 4: at 0 every draw is the average of the two limits, 1 is a bell curve, 2 an even spread, 3 avoids the middle, and 4 draws only the two limits
Sets the lower end of the range random values are drawn from, -10V to 10V; if it is set above the other limit the two are swapped
Leans the probability curve towards the lower or the upper limit, -1 to 1, and has no effect unless the three-way switch is set to Both
Picks which part of the probability curve is drawn from: its left half, its whole width, or its right half
Latches; lit, a new random value is drawn every sample and the TRIG input is not read

inputs.text: A trigger draws a new random value, which OUT holds until the next trigger; a polyphonic cable triggers each channel separately

outputs.text: Carries the random value drawn at the last trigger, somewhere between the two limits

notes: a value is drawn only when a trigger arrives at TRIG or while CONT is lit; with neither, OUT holds 0V
the module has no menu items of its own
